verdict.rationale: Apify exposes a public API, so a documented per-key rate limit is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack states a requests-per-second or per-minute limit or a throttling threshold. Client-side retry behavior and HTTP-status error subclasses are adjacent features, not a documented rate limit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
